# Page 6^page=6
Statements that conflict The Agency Summary & Certification page is signed by 'Larry Stokes' as Department Director dated 10/29/2025, but all organizational charts and division descriptions throughout the document consistently list 'Scott Stokes' as Director of ITD. These appear to be two different names for the same position, suggesting either a data entry error in the certification signature or the existence of two different individuals — one of whom (Larry) does not appear in the org charts. “Certification page: 'Larry Stokes Signature of Department Director: 10/29/2025'; Org chart page 6: 'Scott Stokes Director'; Agency performance report p. 250: 'L. Scott Stokes, Director'” — provided text The Aeronautics FY2025 Total Appropriation summary shows $41,352,700 total, but FY2025 Actual Expenditures for Aeronautics (TRFG) total only $12,914,000 — a gap of approximately $28.4M. A large reappropriation of $25,233,600 is shown as a legislative reappropriation reduction (DU 1.71), suggesting significant unspent funds were carried forward rather than expended. “Agency Summary: 'Aeronautics TRFG FY 2025 Total Appropriation 41,352,700 / FY 2025 Total Expenditures 12,914,000'; Decision unit 1.71: '22102 Dedicated (25,233,600)'” — provided text The FY2027 Budget Request for the Aeronautics appropriation unit (TRFG) total is stated as $4,843,600, while the FY2026 Total Appropriation was $41,760,700 — a reduction of approximately $36.9M. The document notes this is primarily due to removal of one-time reappropriation authority for airport development grants and Leading Idaho funding, but the magnitude of the drop from appropriation to request warrants scrutiny. “Agency Summary: 'Aeronautics TRFG FY2026 Estimated Expenditures 41,760,700 / FY2027 Total Request 4,843,600'” — provided text The FY2026 Estimated Expenditures for the Contract Construction & Right-of-Way Acquisition division (TRFF) are $850,517,200, while the FY2027 Total Request is only $608,992,000 — a reduction of $241.5M. The document attributes this to removal of one-time reappropriation authority, but the FY2025 Total Appropriation was $1,256,104,000 while actual expenditures were $695,224,600, indicating persistent large gaps between appropriation and actual spending. “Agency Summary table: 'Contract Construction TRFF FY2025 Total Appropriation 1,256,104,000 / FY2025 Total Expenditures 695,224,600 / FY2026 Original Appropriation 608,992,000 / FY2026 Estimated Expenditures 850,517,200 / FY2027 Total Request 608,992,000'” — provided text The State Highway Account - Dedicated/State Fund (26002) shows a projected ending unobligated cash balance of negative $174,203,400 by end of FY2027, despite total investments of $183,935,300. This structural negative cash position is a growing trend: FY24 ending balance was -$34,513,900; FY25 was -$63,604,300; FY26 estimate is -$118,735,700. The fund is increasingly relying on direct investments to maintain solvency. “Fund 26002 Analysis of Fund Balances Row 35: FY24 (34,513,900), FY25 (63,604,300), FY26 estimate (118,735,700), FY27 estimate -174,203,400; Row 36 Investments: consistently $183,935,300” — provided text The State Highway Account - Federal Fund (26003) similarly shows a deeply negative and worsening unobligated cash balance: FY24 -$10,908,000; FY25 -$69,554,200; FY26 estimate -$102,327,900; FY27 estimate -$139,075,500. Unlike Fund 26002, there are no direct investments to offset this. The fund relies on reappropriation authority to cover the gap between expenditures and available cash. “Fund 26003 Analysis of Fund Balances Row 35: FY24 (10,908,000), FY25 (69,554,200), FY26 (102,327,900), FY27 -139,075,500; Row 36: all zeros” — provided text The Aeronautics Fund 22102 Analysis of Fund Balances shows a negative ending unobligated cash balance of -$1,799,300 projected for FY26 and -$1,517,600 for FY27, yet the fund has direct investments of $1,998,984 — meaning the fund depends entirely on those investments to remain solvent. The FY2025 actual ending unobligated balance was positive $5,901,400, showing a dramatic deterioration. “Fund 22102 Analysis Row 35: FY25 5,901,400; FY26 (1,799,300); FY27 -1,517,600; Row 36: $1,998,984 investments; Row 37 (Ending Unobligated + Investments): FY26 $199,684; FY27 $481,384” — provided text Employee Jacob Stokes (Agency 290) received a $1,500 recruitment bonus on 06/21/2025. The Director of ITD is listed as Scott Stokes (also signed as 'L. Scott Stokes' in performance report). The shared surname is notable though not necessarily improper; however, hiring/bonus documentation for an employee with the same surname as the Director warrants verification of any familial relationship and compliance with nepotism policies. 7/27/26, 10:05 AM Investigation R eport — July 27, 2026 file:///C:/U sers/loganf/Downloads/tributary-report.html 6/10
